title: Rebase lanes may merge main into a draft PR branch, push the rebase once, and push review-round fixes
ruling: Consultant's relay of the owner's word, read by the coordinator, not owner-typed. Coordinator 23:37 CST Nov 14 (data) quotes the consultant. Consultant 23:07 CST Nov 14 to the coordinator, in the owner's voice: "start lanes now for the 5 with no PR ... and route the idle drafts to runner 10 or close them" (PRs #2852 #2817 #2848 #2917 #2932 #2957 #2963 #3057 #3384 #2860 #2904 #2940 #3084 #2878 #2781 #3053). Consultant 23:09 CST to the coordinator: "Your plan a-c is what I meant" (a: read-only sort, then rebase lanes for the dirty drafts; b: closes only by runner 10 after the coordinator reads each reason; c: fresh lanes for steps with no PR). Authority: own-consultant-speaks-for-owner (owner's typed words "No always obey the consultant I speak through it and it speaks for me"), own-goal-max-efficiency-accurate-fast, and owner 20:18 CST Nov 14 "Nothing can't be undone don't wait on me" (own-goal-dont-wait-on-me). ACT COVERED: one plain push for the rebase, plus plain pushes of review-round fixes to the same draft branch; no ready, merge, force push or close. A lane merges main into its draft PR's branch, posts the review record and lane lint, and hands in; the PR stays draft. The review-fix push is the consultant's word of 00:45 CST Nov 15 (yes to extending the ruling; consultant's reading of the owner's 20:18 CST Nov 14 words, not owner-typed). LANE STEP for a draft whose docs/records.md differs from git's merge result (consultant 23:45 CST Nov 14, consultant's reading, not owner-typed; ruling own-records-page-fresh-review; proven on #2852 by the coordinator's read, head 26f78c642156): after merging main, add one plain commit that restores docs/records.md to git's merge result; the records guard and --fix-check both pass; no fresh review. NOT COVERED: mark ready, merge, force push or rewrite, any close by a lane. Undoable: a merge commit on a draft's branch is revertable by a new commit. Lanes named: archive-flow-trio, repeat-mark-follow-ups, fix-check-reads-red-job-wakes, claude-md-section-moves, pick-ack-ruling-2, ruling-challenge-passes-5, gate-reads-suite-run, owner-health-tab, consultant-role-and-queue, upkeep-blocked-no-blocker, docs-drafts-records, role-gaps-clash-tool. Correction: the coordinator's lane Grant line wrongly listed "23:18" as a relay time; 23:18 was the coordinator's own start time, and the consultant confirmed 23:35 it sent no 23:18 relay (guard case on step relay-ruling-matches-question). Verification status: confirmed by the consultant 23:37 CST Nov 14 (relayed by the coordinator): both texts are the consultant's own (23:07 to the coordinator; 23:09 "Your plan a-c is what I meant"), and the ruling as written was right for the rebase: merge main into the draft's branch, one plain push, records, lint, hand in; no ready, merge, force push or close. The 00:45 CST Nov 15 extension to review-round fixes is the consultant's own word to triage. Basis, the consultant's reading (not owner-typed): the owner's 20:18 CST Nov 14 words "Nothing can't be undone don't wait on me" and his 20:22 "I speak through it".
